## Review

Work through the code the way a defect report works: what is wrong, where, how to reproduce it, how severe it is.

| # | Severity | Location | Issue | How I confirmed it |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | critical / major / minor | line or function | | ran it with input X, read the docs for Y, ... |

### Correctness
- Does it do what the task asked? Which inputs break it (empty, duplicate, very large, wrong type, unicode)?

### Edge cases and error handling
- What happens on bad input, missing files, network failure?

### Security and safety
- Injection, unsafe deserialisation, hard-coded secrets, unsafe file paths.

### Tests
- Which tests would have caught the issues above? Were any tests generated, and are they meaningful?

### Readability and maintainability
- Naming, structure, comments that lie, dead code.

## Verdict

(Accept / Accept with fixes / Reject). One or two lines on why.
